result.title: Decision Aware Origin-Destination Demand Estimation with Structurally Constrained Data
result.summary: Origin-destination (OD) demand plays an important role in transportation system design and management applications. Conventional OD estimation methods typically judge estimation quality based on how estimated demand aligns with observed traffic data and historical demand patterns. We argue that data alignment alone is insufficient; how errors in OD estimates influence downstream decision quality should also be considered. This paper develops a decision aware OD demand estimation framework that leverages structurally constrained traffic data to characterize an admissible demand region, within which we identify OD estimates that would lead to least regret in the downstream decision. Therefore, our OD estimates are both data-consistent and decision-relevant. Methodologically, we approximate the admissible demand region induced by physical network constraints through a geometric representation, which regularizes the search over feasible OD estimates. Within this regularized region, we use a convex surrogate of downstream regret to obtain a tractable decision aware optimization problem. Numerical experiments show that the proposed framework consistently reduces decision regret relative to conventional estimation benchmarks, demonstrating the value of aligning OD demand estimation with downstream decision quality.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究交通 OD 需求估计，主张仅与观测数据对齐不足，应兼顾下游决策质量；方法上用几何表示刻画网络物理约束下的可行需求域以正则化搜索，并用下游后悔值的凸替代构造可解的决策感知优化问题，实验显示决策后悔低于传统基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接关联，但「以中间估计对下游决策的后悔而非数据拟合度作为评价目标」的思路，可能可供核查 latent 推理状态的「使用」评价与贡献分配，例如判断 latent 是否真正改善最终答案而非仅与视觉输入一致。
